title: [EB World Plus] Trade in Xbox Series X Disc Console for $750 Cash or Credit (in-Store) @ EB Games
body:
Deal: [EB World Plus] Trade in Xbox Series X Disc Console for $750 Cash or Credit (in-Store) @ EB Games

[theknight27] That's more than you used to be able to buy them for! I can see $900 for PS5 Pro as well, but can't see if they're taking regular/disc PS5s.
[couger] They did last time, ps5 disc for $750, i traded mine and bought a 2nd hand ps5 pro.
[kingmoron] Lol eb buying them for that price. What kind of price are they new…. WHAT IN THE TARNATION $1100.00
[simontadaa] Its alot worse when you remember it came out 6 years ago. Potentially 6 year old abused consoles selling for msrp soon
[TheDukeOfNukem] Very tempted. I'll be getting the next Xbox day one, and have 3 Series S' in the house. Could ditch the X for what I paid for it all the way back at day one. Crazy prospect.
Would rather play GTA6 on the X than an S though. Hope they bring back the PS5 750 deal, forgot to trade mine in last time, barely used the damn thing in 6 years :'(
[TheDukeOfNukem] It crossed my mind, but there's nothing in that for me.
The only games all generation I gave a toss about were Ratchet (for the missus) and Spider-Man 2. And I have since bought both on Steam anyway.
Playing backups doesn't appeal to me when I own all the games I want elsewhere. Playing emulators doesn't appeal to me when I've had DevMode on Xbox since 2020. Unless there's some cool stuff I'm out of the loop on (and there likely is), it's not particularly enticing to me unfortunately.
[Mikael] Got an old ps5 digital. Easy to jailbreak? Just collecting dust.
[Wilburre] Web-based exploit for 12.00 and under. Possible above that up to 12.70 but requires a modicum of effort.
[HaydosK] Tell me what version it is and I can help you. Other than that I can't say for sure if it's jailbreakable
[Securityclearance] If they had a deal for the s i’d trade mine in, not interested in console gta
[mystarey] Arbitrage opportunity for people who have the $400 cashback on $1000 spend at Microsoft from their Westpac or NAB credit cards given they're $1099 new. ;)
[softwhite] Not worth the fuss for 50 bucks to me personally
[bigAlOz] Noticed that trade-in for cash is not available in WA. Does anyone know why?
[yak] Probably our laws and restrictions around selling stolen goods to stores like Cash Converters. The stat. dec., 100 pts of ID, 14-day holding period, mandatory reporting of item serial numbers and descriptions to police… I can see how they’d apply here too. And be too much of a pain for EB to deal with.
Junkies have to sell on Facebook Marketplace like everyone else. 😉
[thegreatermamba] I have one X lying around which I am tempted to do for this but it has a lot of save data. Is there a way for me to preserve it for future Xbox?
[Commander Shepard] Do we need to provide a controller to get the trade in? Or just the console + power & HDMI
[mordinhoz] Assuming you need controller too. Not sure if box is needed.
[couger] If you dont return the controller, they will deduct it from the credit.
[pj1351] IIRC, EB Games' policy is that if you're missing any core item on their list, they'll deduct the equivalent value from whatever you would otherwise get for the trade-in.
[stealth007] thanks just dont worry about helping no point asking, good luck with your hobby it was a question hence the caps not a comment so it stood out and didnt get answer
[Lets Go Brandon] I bought a 2025 build XSX 3 months ago on marketplace for $450. Got it to play GTA6 but now I can see the game will be woke slop I'll sell it for $1k during the peak madness.
[HaydosK] I see your username makes perfect sense.
[Sleptice] Dam, so it would be smart buying them from cash converters, which I saw they had for like 500, and sell them to these lots for 700 that like 200 profit.
[QuickToThePointless] great plan - except cashies ones smell like meth and have ciggy stub marks on them, so will deduct like $201
